distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) and Huang & Lu (2015) report Yunnan; the 1984 source specifies Menghai in Xishuangbanna. Lin & Beaver (2021) documents the first Taiwan record, with Nantou trap collections and a Taichung breeding series from Cinnamomum subavenium.

host_note: Yin et al. (1984) and Huang & Lu (2015) support Cinnamomum camphora in China. Lin & Beaver (2021) documents breeding from Cinnamomum subavenium in Taiwan. Cinnamomum iners is cited from older literature in Lin & Beaver (2021) and has not been promoted to the reviewed host list.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Phloeosinus camphoratus Tsai & Yin, 1964.

taxonomic_history.name: Phloeosinus camphoratus

nomenclature_note: Canonical identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Phloeosinus camphoratus Tsai & Yin, 1964, VSN_4002. The legacy profile body's Schedl, 1951 authorship is superseded by the canonical identity.
